Flue QA Agents — architecture

A local-first QA workflow in two phases, with a human review workspace and approval gate between them. Host code sequences every stage; each AI agent runs as its own process, holds only narrow tools, and can write only its own schema- and semantically-validated JSON artifact. Models run on a local Ollama or on OpenRouter, selected by QA_MODEL.

Diagrams show structure, not configuration: no model name, context size or test count belongs here. Those live in .env.example and the runbook.

Phase 1

A stage passes only if its artifact was written during that attempt and re-validates from disk. The run stops after stage 5; review and approval are separate, human-started steps.

%% Phase 1 (npm run qa:manual). Stage list: scripts/lib/phase1-stages.mjs.

    a1[("discovered-behavior.json")]

    a2[("requirements-analysis.json")]

    a3[("test-cases.json")]

    a4[("automation-prioritization.json")]

    a5[("defect-analysis.json<br/>bugs/BUG-NNN.json")]
    ev[("discovery-evidence.json<br/>host-collected")]

    stop(["STOP · phase1-run.json"])

    review["QA Review Workspace / qa:review (advisory)<br/>change requests · bug decisions · refresh"]

Discovery

The browser's own reports, read by host code as they pass, decide whether discovery may finish — never the model's account of what it did. Helper origins are host configuration the model is told about and cannot extend.

%% Product Discovery, stage 1 of Phase 1. The host observes the browser; the model never supplies these facts.
flowchart TD
    subgraph config ["Host configuration"]
        target["TARGET_URL"]
        aux["QA_DISCOVERY_AUX_ORIGINS<br/>helper origins, e.g. a test mailbox"]
    end

    pre["Preflight snapshot of the entry page"]
    surface[("Discovery surface<br/>discovery-surface.json")]
    agent["Product Discovery agent<br/>allowlisted browser tools · record_observation · own write tool"]
    mcp["Playwright MCP<br/>signed out when started fresh"]
    intercept["Host interceptor on every browser result"]
    track["Action / observation tracking<br/>state-changing actions await a snapshot"]
    nav["Navigation awareness<br/>newly exposed links · scope: product / helper / other"]
    delta["Snapshot delta hints<br/>what changed since the last look"]
    ledger[("Observation ledger<br/>discovery-observations.json")]

    write["write_qa_artifact discovered-behavior"]
    validate["Schema + semantic validation<br/>every surface location and observation accounted for"]
    gate{{"Discovery Completion Gate<br/>host evidence of unfinished exploration?"}}
    artifact[("discovered-behavior.json")]
    evidence[("discovery-evidence.json<br/>console + network, host session")]

Review workspace

Nothing in the workspace changes test-cases.json until a person applies a proposal the host has validated against the current suite.

%% Test-case revision in the QA Review Workspace (npm run qa:ui).
flowchart TD
    current[("Current test case<br/>test-cases.json")]
    human(["Person"])
    action["Edit · Request Change · + Add Test Case · Delete"]
    request[("Change request<br/>reviews/requests/REQ-NNNN.json<br/>base suite SHA-256")]

    agent["Focused review agent<br/>read_change_request · submit_test_case_proposal<br/>no artifact write tool"]
    hostdel["Host builds the deletion proposal<br/>no model"]
    proposal[("Proposal<br/>reviews/proposals/PRP-NNNN.json<br/>complete resulting case(s)")]

    diff["Workspace diff<br/>CURRENT vs PROPOSED · validation · coverage impact<br/>duplicates · unresolved issues"]
    decide{"Person decides"}
    validate["Host validation at apply<br/>base hash unchanged · schema · semantic · no unresolved issues"]
    write[("test-cases.json<br/>atomic replace")]

    stale["Prioritization + defect analysis STALE<br/>Phase 1 approval STALE"]
    refresh["Refresh dependent analysis<br/>Automation Prioritizer → Defect Analyzer<br/>all or nothing, started by a person"]
    reapprove{{"Approve Phase 1 again"}}

    bugs[("Bug reports<br/>bugs/BUG-NNN.json")]
    bugdecide["Bug decisions<br/>Accept · Reject · Downgrade · Request Changes · Edit"]
    bughist[("reviews/bugs/BUG-NNN.json")]

    current --> human --> action --> request
    request -->|update / create| agent --> proposal
    request -->|delete| hostdel --> proposal
    proposal --> diff --> decide
    decide -->|Request Changes, with a note| agent
    decide -->|Reject| closed(["Request closed · suite unchanged"])
    decide -->|Apply| validate
    validate -->|conflict or invalid: nothing written| diff
    validate --> write --> stale --> refresh --> reapprove
    refresh -->|reconciles decisions on matching bugs| bugs

    human --> bugdecide
    bugdecide -->|re-validated against evidence| bugs
    bugdecide --> bughist
    bugs -. sourceTestCaseIds .-> current
    bugdecide -->|approval STALE| reapprove

    class agent,refresh agent
    class hostdel,diff,validate,stale host
    class current,request,proposal,write,bugs,bughist artifact
    class human,action,bugdecide,decide person
    class reapprove gate
    class closed entry

Trust boundaries

%% Trust boundaries: what a model can influence, and what only host code or a person can do.
flowchart TD
    subgraph untrusted ["Model-controlled"]
        agent["LLM agent"]
        output["Proposed artifact / proposal"]
    end

    subgraph host ["Host code · trusted"]
        tools["Narrow tools<br/>fixed roots outside the project · own artifact only<br/>no shell, no path arguments"]
        schema["JSON Schema validation<br/>Ajv, Draft 2020-12"]
        semantic["Semantic validation<br/>against host-loaded evidence · ids must resolve"]
        redact["Redaction<br/>credentials and one-time values"]
        op["Host-controlled operation<br/>atomic write · base-hash check · run lock"]
    end

    subgraph people ["Person"]
        apply(["Apply proposal / bug decision"])
        approve(["Phase 1 approval<br/>SHA-256 of canonical artifacts"])
    end

    canonical[("Canonical state<br/>QA artifacts on disk")]
    ui["Workspace UI"]
    api["Workspace host API<br/>strict JSON · pattern-checked ids<br/>same-origin writes only"]

    agent -->|only via| tools
    tools --> output
    output --> redact --> schema --> semantic --> op
    op -->|Phase 1 stage artifacts| canonical
    op -->|test-case proposals wait for| apply
    apply --> op
    canonical --> approve
    approve -->|gates| phase2["Phase 2"]

    ui -->|fixed operations| api
    api --> op
    ui -. "cannot name a path, file,<br/>command, script or agent" .-x canonical
    agent -. "cannot read or write" .-x approve
